messages:
oncall-bot: URGENT: Incident INC-2026-042 - elevated tail latency and error rate observed on dedicated pool dp-halcyon-prod (Halcyon VPC). Paging @maria (oncall) and eng-sre. Link: https://ops.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-042

maria (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Standup bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-042. Initial triage now.

tony (eng-sre): Joining. Observed 95p latency spikes to 3.2s and token queue growth on nodes gpu-3,gpu-5. Error rates (503/502) rising for many customers, but top contributor is tenant halcyon-tenant-burst (single tenant > 60% of pool RPS).

maria (oncall): Confirming noisy tenant signal. Correlating logs -> many sustained concurrent long-poll requests and repeated retried batches from that tenant.

raj (eng-runtime): Pushing temporary isolation command to reduce blast radius: `runtimesctl isolate-tenant halcyon-tenant-burst --target-pool standby-gpu --graceful 30s` (started). Also applying per-tenant rate limit: `runtimesctl set-quota halcyon-tenant-burst --rps 10`.

tony (eng-sre): Noted KV cache pressure on nodes; evicting large caches from non-impacted tenants to free memory (in progress). Autoscaler triggered +2 nodes for dp-halcyon-prod.

oncall-bot: ACTION APPLIED by maria at 5423456800: circuit-breaker rate-limit 10 rps applied to halcyon-tenant-burst. Isolation move initiated to standby pool.

maria (oncall): Monitoring. Other tenants' latency back to nominal within 60s. Halcyon customers may see 503/429 during cutover (~T+30s).

nina (cs): I told Halcyon support we saw degraded performance for their app and we're actively isolating the noisy tenant. They want an ETA and an exec-level summary after. Any ETA on full mitigation?

raj (eng-runtime): Isolation completes in ~2m (cache sync). Standby pool ready, traffic shifted. Halcyon-tenant-burst now on standby-gpu with enforced quota; native KV warmup happening.

tony (eng-sre): Verified tail latency on dp-halcyon-prod stable. Noisy tenant limited and moved. 503 spikes dropped back to baseline.

sarah (pm): Need a customer-facing note and proposal for a credit. Quick suggestion: 10% credit for impacted hour and an exec summary. Thoughts?

nina (cs): Customer asking for RCA + timeline. I'll draft initial customer note: short mitigation summary + promise for RCA and credit proposal. They asked for exec brief by EOD.

raj (eng-runtime): Preliminary root cause: tenant-side batch job created sustained high parallelism (long-lived connections + keep-alive), combined with missing per-tenant default quota after a recent config migration (config drift). The runtime accepted requests until queue/backpressure caused other tenants' requests to see queuing and occasional 503s.

maria (oncall): Post-incident actions I propose: 1) make per-tenant hard quota default on dedicated pools, 2) add runtime circuit-breaker to auto-throttle single-tenant share >30% of pool RPS, 3) add alert for single-tenant share spike, 4) ensure isolation runbook updated with `runtimesctl` commands.

tony (eng-sre): Also: return 429 with Retry-After header on throttled requests (current behavior surfaced 503 for some flows). Update model-serving adapter to surface retry hints.

sarah (pm): For customer comms: Nina to send initial mitigation note now; Engineering/Research to produce RCA draft in shared doc by EOD. I will prepare an exec summary slide (1 page).

nina (cs): Sending initial note now: "We mitigated impact at T+5m by isolating the tenant and applying rate limiting; services restored for other tenants. We are preparing a full RCA and a proposed credit. Expect RCA draft by EOD." Halcyon wants the exec brief by 17:00 PT.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll own the RCA draft. Root cause section + timeline + remediation steps. Assigning follow-ups: quota-default (raj), circuit-breaker impl (maria + tony), alerting (tony), docs/playbook (maria).

maria (oncall): Marking incident as 'monitoring' and will keep bridge open for 30m. Watching for regressions.

oncall-bot: BRIDGE STATUS: mitigation applied, monitoring. Next check-in scheduled at 5423456900.

nina (cs): Customer asked about credits. I'll propose 10% credit for the impacted hour and mention our remediation commitments.

sarah (pm): Agree 10% seems reasonable as interim. Finance to confirm final numbers. Also note: if SLA breach confirmed, we'll follow SLA formula for credits and notify legal for contract flag.

maria (oncall): After 30m stable monitoring, I'll close the bridge. Final timeline and RCA link will be posted to this thread.

ton (eng-sre): (reacts :thumbsup:)

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: closed-monitoring -> resolved at 5423457089. Summary posted to ops wiki: https://ops.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-042/summary

maria (oncall): Closing notes: impact window ~5423456740 - 5423456840 (~100s of elevated tail latency + short 503 window during cutover). Owners: RCA=raj, Playbook=maria, Alerting=tony, CS comms=nina.
